rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3AA blastocyst, but it overstates image-specific certainty by asserting features like no vacuolization, minimal multinucleation, and absence of degenerative changes that are not reliably confirmed from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and first-cycle status well, though some links are somewhat speculative and not all factors are equally evidence-based.

The logic is structured and the prognosis estimate broadly follows from embryo quality plus endometriosis adjustment, but a few claims are overstated and the final summary shifts from implantation probability toward live birth probability.

Core recommendations like single embryo transfer are guideline-concordant, but several adjuncts and future plans (endometrial scratch, ERA after one failure, routine aspirin/steroids, prolonged progesterone, PGT-A recommendation based mainly on age 35-36) are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, but some suggested interventions are controversial or insufficiently qualified for routine use.
